description: Anchura de Carreteras is a dataset listed in analisis.datosabiertos.jcyl.es open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Junta de Castilla y León. Anchos pavimentados de carreteras pertenecientes a la red de titularidad de la Comunidad Autónoma. Frecuencia de actualización: Anual. Coverage: Castilla y León. The portal files it under Urban planning and infrastructure. Its keywords are transporte, redes de transporte, red viaria, red de carreteras. The portal shows 1,560 records. The portal shows 2026-05-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-analisis-datosabiertos-jcyl-es-portal.
